decisions.reason: As a large expanding telecom provider with slack and a strategy centred on cloud-based customer communications, the firm would likely retain this adjacent cloud contact centre offer after only one year because it fits existing capabilities and the limited evidence does not yet show performance clearly below aspiration.

Management would likely keep the call number routing platform because it is very close to the established core offer, was promoted with its own page, and in a broad stable portfolio such an incremental service would usually be given more time unless results clearly fell short of aspiration.
